title: Optimal ratcheting dividend policies with resets
abstract: arXiv:2610.34348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study an optimal dividend policy problem under ratcheting and bankruptcy constraints. Firms face a tradeoff between the negative signal of a dividend reduction and a potential future bankruptcy. In contrast to previous works, the dividend rate is allowed to decrease after incurring a negative impact on equity valuation in accordance with a large empirical literature on the topic. We provide an explicit necessary and sufficient condition for the finiteness of the value function and prove the differentiability of the value function, and its characterization via viscosity solutions and the so-called supercontact property. The value function is given by the solution of a two-dimensional variational inequality combining optimal stopping, singular and impulse controls. translated_title: 具有重置机制的最优棘轮式股利政策
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在棘轮约束和破产约束下的最优股利政策问题。企业面临着股利削减所传递的负面信号与潜在未来破产之间的权衡。与以往研究不同，本文允许股息率在股权估值遭受负面影响后下调，这与该领域大量的实证文献相一致。我们给出了价值函数有限性的显式充要条件，证明了价值函数的可微性，并通过粘性解和所谓的“超接触”性质对其进行了刻画。价值函数由一个结合了最优停时、奇异控制和脉冲控制的二维变分不等式的解给出。我们证明该问题等价于一维设定，从而简化了数学和金融两方面的分析。最后，我们对模型进行了数值研究。
tldr: 本文研究了棘轮与破产约束下的最优股利政策，创新性地允许股息率在股权估值受损后下调，给出了价值函数有限性的充要条件，并将二维变分不等式问题等价化简为一维问题，兼顾了数学与金融分析。
en_tdlr: This paper studies optimal dividend policies under ratcheting and bankruptcy constraints, innovatively allowing dividend rates to decrease after negative equity valuation impacts, providing an explicit necessary and sufficient condition for value function finiteness, and proving an equivalence that reduces the two-dimensional variational inequality problem to a one-dimensional setting.
